name: Team Review
author: GlossX
description: An agent team reviews several papers: one reader per paper, a critic cross-checks their findings for conflicts and weak support, readers answer the critic's challenges, then a writer synthesises a cited review.

capability.card: Team review of several papers: parallel readers, a critic that cross-checks conflicting or unsupported findings, a rebuttal round, then a cited synthesis.

args.instructions: Synthesise the team's findings into a short review organised by theme, naming the paper behind every point. Where the critic found a conflict, present both sides with their citations and say which the evidence favours after the readers' answers; if it stays open, say so.
